files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- `appinfo/info.xml` did not validate against the App Store schema: `<php>`
  must come before `<nextcloud>` inside `<dependencies>`. The store rejects such
  a release outright, which kept 1.1.0 from being published. No functional
  change from 1.1.0.

### Added
- CI validates `appinfo/info.xml` against the App Store schema (`info.xsd`).
